input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "I know you must be busy, so I truly appreciate you taking the time to help me. For weeks now, I've been feeling low and just can't figure out how to start my university thesis. What would you suggest I do first?"
Message B: "I've been feeling low for weeks and can't figure out how to start my university thesis. What should I do first?"

Which writer comes across as more **warm, polite and considerate**?
(Kind, respectful, cooperative and trusting.)

Answer "A" or "B".
